app/src/lib/api.ts:305-310 — getVersionGroup adds a second memoization layer on top of fetchJson's cache (api.ts:74-89), redundant abstraction
app/src/components/MoveTables.tsx:10-40 — good stretch: SortKey/column model driven by data, cleanly handles the Level Up variation without flags
app/src/lib/api.ts:186-221 — cardsFromPokemonRefs is a real shared abstraction: one function serves moves, abilities and types pages, with a narrow hiddenFor callback
app/src/lib/api.ts:291-294 — evolutionTree and the STAT_LABELS/METHOD_ORDER tables show variation is modelled as data, not parameters
abstraction_design.rationale: There are real, well-shaped abstractions (cardsFromPokemonRefs, MoveTable's column model), but the one place the app actually varied — the home card vs plain card — was solved by copy-paste rather than a shared component, and some helpers exist in half-adopted form.

findings.issue: HomeCards duplicates PokemonCards' card markup (sprite/number/name link) with only a types-row added, so any card change is made twice
findings.suggestion: Merge into one PokemonCards component with an optional types field (or a renderless card + slot) so the home page passes HomeCard and the rest pass PokemonCard

findings.issue: Five handlers each hand-roll pushState/replaceState plus URL rebuild, and a popstate listener re-parses the URL, instead of using qwik-city's useNavigate for query-param updates
findings.suggestion: Extract a single setFilter(key, value) / goToPage(n) helper (or switch to useNavigate) so URL semantics live in one place

findings.issue: The sprite rule is applied at two construction sites (home index and cardsFromPokemonRefs), so the Deoxys-style species/pokémon sprite fix must be made twice
findings.suggestion: Route both card builders through one makeCard(id, name) helper in api.ts

findings.issue: typeClassName helper is dead code while `type-${name}` is built inline in four files (ui.tsx:7, MoveTables.tsx:82, routes/pokemon/[name]/index.tsx:58, routes/moves/[name]/index.tsx:28)
findings.suggestion: Delete the helper or actually use it everywhere; better, render links through the TypeBadge component

findings.issue: getVersionGroup maintains a second promise cache keyed on a global, redundant with fetchJson's cache
findings.suggestion: Call fetchJson directly and drop the __pokedexVersionGroups map

findings.issue: The data layer is internally typed as any (fetchJson returns any, payloads accessed with any casts), weakening the module's own contracts despite well-typed exports
findings.suggestion: Define minimal payload interfaces for move/pokemon/species detail so future edits get compile-time feedback

findings.issue: One 669-line global stylesheet means removing a feature (e.g. abilities) leaves dead rules like .abilities-list behind
findings.suggestion: Adopt Qwik's scoped useStyle$ or CSS modules per component/route, or at least group page-specific rules under comment banners

summary: A cleanly layered Qwik City app: thin routes, all server access and caching confined to src/lib/api.ts, dumb typed components, and shared helpers in lib/format.ts — most bug fixes and the data-source change land in one file. Weak spots are the duplicated home/plain card markup, five-fold repetition of manual URL-state handling in the home route, and half-adopted helpers (typeClassName, double caching). Net: easy to change, with a few copy-paste seams a reviewer would ask to be merged.
